Six successful single-turn slices share one bounded root budget and do not consume the legacy failed-retry budget; an unchanged completed inquiry reuses its cached job and deadline.
Parent and child turns share the same six-turn root budget, resume under the synthesis policy, and retain the model-visible child result only in the private worker request.
Private descendant dispatch stops at depth two through the actual JobService path.
limits: These tests establish source-level scheduling, persistence, deadline, admission, cache, and provenance behavior using scripted CPU fixtures; they do not qualify model reasoning, inference quality, GPU behavior, or an installed release.
